in_marathi.name: Tirupathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Seven Hills
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tirupathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tirupathi is derived from the Tamil words Tiru, which means 'holy' or 'sacred', and Pathi, which means 'lord' or 'master'. Tirupathi is the name of the sacred hill in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh, and is also the name of the deity Lord Venkateswara who is believed to reside on this hill.

Tirupathi is the name of the sacred hill in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh, and is also the name of the deity Lord Venkateswara who is believed to reside on this hill.
